title: B2B Industrial / Manufacturing / Distribution
description: Long cycles, specification-driven buyers, distribution through reps and dealers. Inherits the committee mechanics of B2B software and replaces the aesthetic and the proof economy: here the spec sheet is the creative.

objection_library: will it integrate with the line we already run
what is the lead time on spares
is it certified for our jurisdiction
what is the total cost including downtime to install
our people are trained on the incumbent
angle_library: total cost of ownership over 5 years

creative.image_style: equipment in a real operating environment, correct PPE on any person in frame, accurate machine geometry, industrial lighting, callout-friendly composition with space for annotation
creative.image_negative: missing PPE, impossible mechanical linkage, sparks used decoratively, unsafe working posture, sterile render with no context
creative.video_style: narrated walkthrough of the mechanism or the install, annotated on screen, shot from an operator's eyeline

plays.title: Downtime cost arithmetic
plays.when: The buyer's pain is measurable in hours of stopped production — the one argument procurement cannot dismiss.

with.check: performance figures traceable to a spec sheet

plays.title: Dealer / rep enablement pack
plays.when: Distribution partners need co-brandable material they will actually use.

prompt_fragments.voice: Your reader maintains this equipment and will catch a wrong figure instantly. Use the units. State assumptions. Never round a tolerance to make a sentence flow.
prompt_fragments.proof_instruction: Standards numbers, certification marks, duty cycles and service intervals are the proof. An adjective is a red flag to this audience.
prompt_fragments.visual_instruction: Every person in frame wears the correct PPE for the environment shown. Mechanical geometry must be plausible; leave clear space for spec callouts.
prompt_fragments.safety_instruction: Never depict an unsafe practice, even incidentally in the background. In this vertical it is both a compliance failure and an instant credibility loss.
